name: Fleet telemetry
summary: GPS tracking for courier vans: every van sends its position every few seconds, dispatchers watch a live map and get alerts when a delivery runs late or a van leaves its zone.

business.customers: Courier and delivery companies pay per van; dispatchers and drivers use it.
critical_flows: A van's position shows on the live map within two seconds

environments.name: prod
environments.purpose: Ingest pipeline, live map API and customer accounts.

environments.name: dev
environments.purpose: A dev stream fed by a trace replay box; no staging, releases go from dev to prod.

users.definition: Dispatchers signed in to the map plus drivers with the app open, per day.
users.note: About 6,000 vans send positions today; vans are devices, not users.
